uhc.text: Upper GI endoscopy with biopsy prices for UnitedHealthcare commercial (employer or individual) plans range from $1,268 to $5,172. The highest price is 4.1 times the lowest. Most prices fall between $1,712 and $5,172, while the median price is $3,200.

bcbs_az.text: Upper GI endoscopy with biopsy prices for Blue Cross Blue Shield of Arizona commercial plans range from $1,783 to $3,700. The median price is $2,751, and most prices fall between $2,025 and $3,700. The highest price is 2.1 times the lowest price.

aetna.text: The price for an upper GI endoscopy with biopsy for Aetna commercial plans ranges from $1,209 to $3,877. The median price is $2,252.

cigna.text: Upper GI endoscopy with biopsy prices for Cigna commercial plans range from $968 to $4,189. The highest price is 4.3 times the lowest, and most prices fall between $1,618 and $3,756.

humana.text: Upper GI endoscopy with biopsy for Humana commercial (employer or individual) plans has a price range from $498 to $4,091. The highest price is 8.2 times the lowest price. The lowest price of $498 appears at 5 HonorHealth hospitals, while the highest price of $4,091 appears at 3 Abrazo Health (Tenet) hospitals.

cash.text: Upper GI endoscopy with biopsy has a cash price ranging from $1,113 at Valleywise Health Medical Center to $15,251 at Wickenburg Community Hospital. The highest price is 13.7 times the lowest, and most prices fall between $1,610 and $3,691, while 90% of cash prices are below the typical insured price.
